purpose: issue #23 same-tree A/B of the reference and optimized K1

build-cuda: ./scripts/with-msvc.ps1 nvcc -O2 -arch=native -Isrc -Ithird_party/random123/include build\main_cuda.obj build\codec_cuda.obj build\quantizer_cuda_host.obj build\rng_cpu_cuda.obj build\quantizer_avx2_cuda.obj build\quantizer_cuda.obj -o build\mco2.exe

toolkit_and_driver.c_compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.51.36260 for x64

protocol.measurand: k1_ms (K1 stage events); the resident total is descriptive
protocol.order: cells shuffled per process round with random.Random(ORDER_SEED); within a cell the reference runs first in even rounds and the optimized K1 first in odd rounds

initial_gpu_warm_up.workload: cuda resident, 8-bit, input_n67108864, 100 reps per process

decision.rule: the optimized K1 is kept only if every dram cell (4 * count >= 4 * L2) has K1 verdict 'faster' with direction_supported (revision 3; no boundary, so no inversion). magnitude_supported and the bootstrap CI are reported; no decision depends on them
